newsitem.title: USA: Sun TV Q4 margins, same-store sales fell.
newsitem.headline: Sun TV Q4 margins, same-store sales fell.

text.p: Sun Television and Appliances Inc said its fourth quarter same-store sales fell sharply, with gross margins also slumping as the company liquidated inventory.

The company said its comparable store sales for the fourth quarter fell 26.6 percent from the same period of the previous fiscal year. Gross margins were 16 percent, compared with 23.6 percent for the fourth quarter last year.
Sun said its margins were pressured by inventory liquidations associated with its store closings.
In January 1997, Sun announced it would close nine stores and reduce its staff by more than 1,000 full-time positions under a restructuring plan.
Late Tuesday, the company reported a fourth quarter net loss of $34.1 million or $1.95 per share, which included a $14.7 million restructuring charge.
